name: [UPDATE] Algicosathlon
desc:
Welcome to Algicosathlon, a competition game based on the Algodoo and marble race series of the same name! Play as any coloured athlete and compete to win challenges, earn points, survive eliminations, and win the game! This game is currently in beta, not every feature will be functional and there may be bugs!

SERVER LINKED BELOW! New game icon by pentaglide_5. Thumbnail arts made by Eletrco Eletrco III, tj and coolguy210. Electro Electro III also made the event icons in Simon Says. Credit to AlviKinROX for the idea for Marble Siege: Vizor, and Cosmic for the idea of Ice Skating.

|| I have been informed there's recently been issues with data loss in this game. If you have lost your data, please join our server, make a report, and I'll try and restore your data as soon as possible.
